import MumfordLib.GroupCohomologyAlternationEquiv
import MumfordLib.SourceComplexAlternatingCohomology

/-!
# Degree-two group and singular cohomology of a compact complex Lie group

Alternation for the finite free intrinsic period lattice and the period-normalized
singular cohomology comparison give an algebraic isomorphism between the actual
group H2 of that lattice and the integral singular H2 of the original group.
It takes cups of the period characters of two singular degree-one classes to
their singular cup product.

The comparison is defined through alternating forms. Its identification with
a comparison induced by cochains or the exponential quotient map, and with a
Chern-class construction, is not asserted here.

Reference: Mumford, *Abelian Varieties*, Chapter I, pp. 3 and 16-17.
-/

set_option autoImplicit false

noncomputable section

open scoped Topology Manifold ContDiff IsMulCommutative

namespace Mumford.Analytic

variable {E G : Type} {H : Type*}
  [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace ℂ E]
  [TopologicalSpace H] (I : ModelWithCorners ℂ E H)
  [TopologicalSpace G] [ChartedSpace H G] [Group G]
  [LieGroup I ω G] [T2Space G] [I.Boundaryless]
  [CompactSpace G] [PreconnectedSpace G]

/-- The algebraic, period-normalized comparison from group H2 of the intrinsic
exponential period lattice to singular H2 of the compact complex Lie group. -/
def compactComplexLieGroupSecondGroupCohomologyEquiv :
    letI : FiniteDimensional ℂ E :=
      FiniteDimensional.of_locallyCompact_manifold G I
    letI : CompleteSpace E := FiniteDimensional.complete ℂ E
    letI : IsMulCommutative G := complexLieGroup_isMulCommutative (G := G) I
    letI : CommGroup G := inferInstance
    groupCohomology.H2 (Rep.trivial ℤ
      (Multiplicative (intrinsicComplexExponentialPeriodLattice (G := G) I)) ℤ) ≃ₗ[ℤ]
        IntegralSingularCohomology (TopCat.of G) 2 := by
  letI : FiniteDimensional ℂ E :=
    FiniteDimensional.of_locallyCompact_manifold G I
  letI : CompleteSpace E := FiniteDimensional.complete ℂ E
  letI : IsMulCommutative G := complexLieGroup_isMulCommutative (G := G) I
  letI : CommGroup G := inferInstance
  letI := (compactComplexLieGroupPeriodLattice_free_finite (G := G) I).1
  letI := (compactComplexLieGroupPeriodLattice_free_finite (G := G) I).2
  exact groupSecondCohomologyAlternationEquiv.trans
    (compactComplexLieGroupCohomologyAlternatingEquiv (G := G) I 2).symm

/-- Alternating period evaluation of the comparison is group-cocycle alternation. -/
@[simp]
theorem compactComplexLieGroupSecondGroupCohomologyEquiv_alternation :
    letI : FiniteDimensional ℂ E :=
      FiniteDimensional.of_locallyCompact_manifold G I
    letI : CompleteSpace E := FiniteDimensional.complete ℂ E
    letI : IsMulCommutative G := complexLieGroup_isMulCommutative (G := G) I
    letI : CommGroup G := inferInstance
    ∀ x : groupCohomology.H2 (Rep.trivial ℤ
      (Multiplicative (intrinsicComplexExponentialPeriodLattice (G := G) I)) ℤ),
      compactComplexLieGroupCohomologyAlternatingEquiv (G := G) I 2
          (compactComplexLieGroupSecondGroupCohomologyEquiv (G := G) I x) =
        groupSecondCohomologyAlternation x := by
  letI : FiniteDimensional ℂ E :=
    FiniteDimensional.of_locallyCompact_manifold G I
  letI : CompleteSpace E := FiniteDimensional.complete ℂ E
  letI : IsMulCommutative G := complexLieGroup_isMulCommutative (G := G) I
  letI : CommGroup G := inferInstance
  letI := (compactComplexLieGroupPeriodLattice_free_finite (G := G) I).1
  letI := (compactComplexLieGroupPeriodLattice_free_finite (G := G) I).2
  intro x
  exact (compactComplexLieGroupCohomologyAlternatingEquiv (G := G) I 2).apply_symm_apply
    (groupSecondCohomologyAlternation x)

/-- On a cocycle representative, the alternating period value is
`F(u,v) - F(v,u)`, with the source order and sign. -/
theorem compactComplexLieGroupSecondGroupCohomologyEquiv_cocycle_period :
    letI : FiniteDimensional ℂ E :=
      FiniteDimensional.of_locallyCompact_manifold G I
    letI : CompleteSpace E := FiniteDimensional.complete ℂ E
    letI : IsMulCommutative G := complexLieGroup_isMulCommutative (G := G) I
    letI : CommGroup G := inferInstance
    ∀ (F : groupCohomology.cocycles₂ (Rep.trivial ℤ
        (Multiplicative (intrinsicComplexExponentialPeriodLattice (G := G) I)) ℤ))
      (v : Fin 2 → intrinsicComplexExponentialPeriodLattice (G := G) I),
      compactComplexLieGroupCohomologyAlternatingEquiv (G := G) I 2
          (compactComplexLieGroupSecondGroupCohomologyEquiv (G := G) I
            (groupCohomology.H2π _ F)) v =
        F (Multiplicative.ofAdd (v 0), Multiplicative.ofAdd (v 1)) -
          F (Multiplicative.ofAdd (v 1), Multiplicative.ofAdd (v 0)) := by
  letI : FiniteDimensional ℂ E :=
    FiniteDimensional.of_locallyCompact_manifold G I
  letI : CompleteSpace E := FiniteDimensional.complete ℂ E
  letI : IsMulCommutative G := complexLieGroup_isMulCommutative (G := G) I
  letI : CommGroup G := inferInstance
  intro F v
  rw [compactComplexLieGroupSecondGroupCohomologyEquiv_alternation,
    groupSecondCohomologyAlternation_π]
  rfl

/-- The comparison sends the group cup of the actual period characters of two
singular degree-one classes to their singular cup product. -/
@[simp]
theorem compactComplexLieGroupSecondGroupCohomologyEquiv_characterCup
    (c d : IntegralSingularCohomology (TopCat.of G) 1) :
    compactComplexLieGroupSecondGroupCohomologyEquiv (G := G) I
        (groupCharacterCupClass
          (compactComplexLieGroupFirstCohomologyPeriodDualEquiv (G := G) I c).toAddMonoidHom
          (compactComplexLieGroupFirstCohomologyPeriodDualEquiv (G := G) I d).toAddMonoidHom) =
      singularCohomologyIteratedCup (TopCat.of G) 2 ![c, d] := by
  letI : FiniteDimensional ℂ E :=
    FiniteDimensional.of_locallyCompact_manifold G I
  letI : CompleteSpace E := FiniteDimensional.complete ℂ E
  letI : IsMulCommutative G := complexLieGroup_isMulCommutative (G := G) I
  letI : CommGroup G := inferInstance
  apply (compactComplexLieGroupCohomologyAlternatingEquiv (G := G) I 2).injective
  rw [compactComplexLieGroupSecondGroupCohomologyEquiv_alternation]
  ext v
  rw [groupSecondCohomologyAlternation_groupCharacterCupClass,
    compactComplexLieGroupCohomologyAlternatingEquiv_iteratedCup]
  simp [Matrix.det_fin_two, mul_comm]

end Mumford.Analytic
